language.label: Language
language.hint: Applied immediately and remembered for the next launches.

title: Configuration

base.label: Folder for new distributions
base.hint: Used by create, import and clone: each distro goes in dossier\nom. Empty = %USERPROFILE%\WSL.

globalFile: The .wslconfig file of your Windows profile. An empty value removes the key.
distroFile: The /etc/wsl.conf file of the distribution. An empty value removes the key.
needStart: "{{name}}" is stopped. To read its wsl.conf, it has to start.
backupNote: A timestamped backup of the old file is created next to it.
restart: Saved. Restart required: run "Stop all" (wsl --shutdown) then restart the distributions to apply.
